scope: Original kit-specific Stat Focus A/B desk research. Each entry compares an existing source-linked community starting choice with an alternative at equal resources; no gameplay measurements, rights clearance or best-in-slot claim.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Emma Frost, a Critical Rating trial changes eligible would-be critical event frequency; it must not be assumed to increase noncritical debuff tick damage. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Build indefinite Prowess with well-timed blocks in Diamond Form. Compare Critical Damage Rating against the same opponent, rank and resources. Do not mistake a changed direct hit for proof of longer resource uptime or stronger debuff ticks.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Emma Frost on defense, Armor Penetration may improve the defender's outgoing direct hits against armored attackers; it does not reduce incoming damage, so a mitigation choice is a real alternative. Kit limitation: Armor Break forces Telepath and prevents returning to Diamond while active. Specials spend Prowess and temporarily switch form. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.
statFocusRecommendation.note: Original dated kit-aware editorial comparison; based on the cited champion rotation and Kabam Stat Focus design, not independent combat tests. Existing community setting remains a hypothesis; Critical Rating versus Critical Damage Rating and Armor Penetration versus Block Proficiency are falsifiable alternatives.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Falcon, Critical Damage Rating can affect eligible direct critical-hit damage; separate that from Fury potency, Damage-over-Time and attacks that do not naturally crit. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Dash back and hold block until Lock On activates. Compare Critical Rating against the same opponent, rank and resources. Do not mistake a changed direct hit for proof of longer resource uptime or stronger debuff ticks.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Falcon on defense, Energy Resistance mitigates eligible incoming energy damage but does not prevent debuff application or special control. Kit limitation: Defensive ability suppression is not blanket control over every mechanic. Check ability-accuracy immunity, resistance and node exceptions before relying on it. Compare Physical Resistance using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Guardian, a Critical Rating trial changes eligible would-be critical event frequency; it must not be assumed to increase noncritical debuff tick damage. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Use Special 1 to add Force Field charges and Taunt, preserving Armor Up. Avoid fourth-light finishers unless their charge-consuming Power Drain is needed. Compare Critical Damage Rating against the same opponent, rank and resources. Guardian converts natural critical opportunities into Shock. Test their resulting Shock pattern separately from direct-hit critical damage.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Guardian on defense, Physical Resistance mitigates eligible incoming physical damage and should not be treated as protection from every energy attack or debuff. Kit limitation: Armor removal disrupts important defensive conditions. His limited Power Drain buys time but is not a permanent power lock. Compare Energy Resistance using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.
